text: We evaluated weak-to-strong generalization by training only a linear head on frozen strong features, using llama-3.1-8b as the strong model and pythia-410m as the weak supervisor, with a probe learning rate of 0.01 and across num_seeds = 3 seeds. The weak supervisor reached 0.66 accuracy and the strong model's ceiling was 0.83, while the linear probe trained on weak labels achieved a transfer accuracy of 0.69 (SE 0.02). The resulting performance gap recovered was 0.18 with a standard error of 0.14, compared with a baseline PGR of 0.28. The measured PGR therefore sits below the baseline, and with only three seeds and a standard error of 0.14 the estimate is too imprecise to support any claim of improvement over the baseline; the difference falls well within two standard errors. These numbers should be read as preliminary, and a larger seed count would be needed to distinguish the linear-probe method from the baseline.
